chunks: Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the pebbles of Jamaraat, he said: 'The smooth ones are disliked from them,' and he said: 'Take the rough ones.'
ai.seo_question: What type of pebbles should be used for throwing at the Jamarat during Hajj?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the prophetic preference for textured pebbles (*bursh*) over smooth ones (*summ*) during the stoning of the Jamarat, reflecting the meticulous attention to ritual detail in Shia fiqh. The distinction underscores the importance of physical characteristics in fulfilling the symbolic act of rejecting Satan, a practice rooted in the traditions of Imam al-Sadiq (AS). This ruling is often discussed alongside the broader jurisprudential debates regarding the validity of using different types of stones during the Hajj rituals.
